channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: Meta signs long-term supply deal with AMD for AI hardware
item.description: The partnership builds on the companies’ existing collaboration and will help expand Meta’s compute power.

item.title: Dept. of Defense signs deal with xAI
item.description: The partnership will allow defense applications and military systems to work with Grok’s models, per an Axios report.

item.title: LinkedIn ID verification partner Persona under fire for security concerns
item.description: A researcher from The Local Stack reported potential data collection questions, leading companies including Discord to reevaluate the system.

item.title: LinkedIn shares top skills on the rise in marketing for 2026
item.description: Social media branding, community engagement and performance analysis were all key trends highlighted in the platform’s annual list.

item.title: TikTok releases its 2026 Discover List
item.description: The sixth iteration of the app’s annual roundup highlighted 50 top creators across five categories.

item.title: YouTube expands voice replies to all creators, adds new Shorts remix options
item.description: The platform also enhanced its Premium Lite subscription program as parent company Google looks to drive revenue for the business.

item.title: FBI investigates X over nude images generated by Grok
item.description: The artificial intelligence platform was also used to generate professional complaints, according to a report from 404 Media in collaboration with Court Watch.

item.title: Instagram’s connected TV app comes to U.S. Google TV devices
item.description: The expansion will allow users to watch Reels on their televisions and provide big screen viewing capabilities for Instagram content.

item.title: Google rolls out updates to image and video tool Flow AI
item.description: New features include an updated user interface, more intuitive editing tools and the ability to generate videos from images using text prompts.

item.title: Snapchat announces new awards show designed to spotlight creators
item.description: The Snappys will be hosted by Snap Star Matt Friend and include a lifetime achievement award for DJ Khaled.
